title: Aesimedes
summary: Raleigh names Aesimedes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Aesimedes, the second of the foure first Gouernours of Athens chosen for ten yeeres. Of him Raleigh findes only the name. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXV, §. IV, sig. 353b
